as_told.title: Oppenheimer and Manhattan Project as original UFO secret keepers

plain: J. Robert Oppenheimer is said to have been the one who set up the secrecy around UFOs, using the same men who kept the atomic bomb secret. Michels says "some interesting people" claim this, among them a man he calls Rush, who he says told him so "on record" in an interview. A man named Bob Maguire, presented on the show as a former CIA contractor, gives it as his own belief: "Oppenheimer and other people in the Manhattan Project were the original secret keepers." If true, UFO secrecy would date back to the very start of the nuclear age.
